text: Based on the tool output, there were no fire detections on the property during the period from October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026. The NASA FIRMS data, which includes detections from multiple sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS), showed zero detections intersecting the asset. All sensors had complete coverage of the period, confirming that no burning occurred on the property during this time.
